name: Kamigawa
description: Kamigawa is a plane reminiscent of sengoku-era Japan, with two symbiotic worlds, the material utsushiyo and the kami spirit realm kakuriyo, and is the home of Kaito, Tamiyo and the Wanderer.

description_citations.text: "The Wanderer". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Kaito Shizuki". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

summary.text: Kamigawa is a plane reminiscent of sengoku-era Japan, with two symbiotic worlds, the material utsushiyo and the kami spirit realm kakuriyo, and is the home of Kaito, Tamiyo and the Wanderer.

citations.text: "The Wanderer". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
"Kaito Shizuki". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Kaito pursues technological progress there, breaking rules to make the world better for himself and his family.

citations.text: "Kaito Shizuki". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: It is revealed to a select few that the Wanderer is the lost empress of Kamigawa, seeking a way home.

citations.text: "The Wanderer". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: The Wanderer is its Emperor and has left Light-Paws as regent.

status.text: The material's events show Kaito working for technological progress and the Wanderer, its lost empress, seeking a way home, with Light-Paws as regent.

citations.text: "The Wanderer". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takeno rallies troops at the Battle of Akagi River.
timeline.quote: The day is not over yet,

citation.text: Call to Glory (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takeno warns his men that the kami are coming, calming Isamaru.
timeline.quote: Alert the men. The kami are coming.

citation.text: Isamaru, Hound of Konda (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takeno tells recruits they are not yet samurai and must defend their homes.
timeline.quote: Defend your homes with honor, die for your cause, and perhaps then you will be worthy of the word.

citation.text: Indomitable Will (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takeno stands alone untouched by despair and rallies the army.
timeline.quote: General Takeno alone was not touched by despair.

citation.text: Soul of Magma (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Spirits of weapons turn against great warriors in the first days of the war.
timeline.quote: Many great warriors died in the first days of the war

citation.text: Kabuto Moth (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lady Azami recommends destroying all shrines of the kami.
timeline.quote: I recommend we proceed with the plan to destroy all shrines of the kami.

citation.text: Azami, Lady of Scrolls (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hisoka advises Konda against the war because it cannot be won.
timeline.quote: I advise against this war.

citation.text: Unnatural Speed (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hisoka tells Konda there can be no victory if kami of the soul rise against mortals.
timeline.quote: There can be no victory in this war.

citation.text: Night of Souls' Betrayal (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Honden of Cleansing Fire is abandoned and its zubera swarm Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: When the Honden of Cleansing Fire was abandoned, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to erode mortal will.

citation.text: Silent-Chant Zubera (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Marrow-Gnawer unites three nezumi gangs by slaying their leaders in one night.
timeline.quote: Marrow-Gnawer united three nezumi gangs when he slew their leaders in a single night.

citation.text: Marrow-Gnawer (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ogres free oni through blood rituals.
timeline.quote: who freed terrifying oni to wander Kamigawa unhindered.

citation.text: Blood Rites (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hoto's last words as a kami attacks Jiro near home.
timeline.quote: The kami would never attack us this close to home

citation.text: Kami of the Hunt (Champions of Kamigawa, 2004), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The spirits of Kamigawa suddenly and inexplicably begin to wage war on the plane's mortal inhabitants.
timeline.quote: the spirits that are the essence of everything on it suddenly and inexplicably begin to wage war with its mortal inhabitants

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko abandons her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi about the kami's rage.
timeline.quote: abandons the shrinking safety of her father's fortress to consult holy monks and the orochi

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko meets the thief Toshi Umezawa and realizes she may need unthinkable alliances.
timeline.quote: she realizes that to avert the destruction of Kamigawa, she may have to make some unthinkable alliances

citation.text: "Champions of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jugan is killed in the Battle of Silk but blesses the monks.
timeline.quote: He was killed but blessed the monks with power even after he was gone

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: More than 1200 years after the Kami War the dragon spirits are reborn.
timeline.quote: the dragons have been reborn and continue to be the protectors of Kamigawa

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu returns with restored eyes, merged with the All-Consuming into a being like the Sisters, and consumes Mochi.
timeline.quote: tearing Mochi into pieces before consuming him

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The theft of O-Kagachi's scion starts the Kami War.
timeline.quote: It was because the theft of O-Kagachi's scion, that the Kami War began.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Myojin of Life's Web has Michiko captured hoping her death would end the war; the princess escapes and the forest is attacked by the Moonfolk of Oboro.
timeline.quote: She had Michiko captured, hoping that her death would end the Kami War.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Notable kami". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yosei is ripped apart in battle against O-Kagachi but survives to help Eiganjo's refugees.
timeline.quote: He was ripped-apart in the battle against O-Kagachi, but survived and helped the Eiganjoan refugees in the battle against the hordes of the Myojin of Infinite Rage.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu and his yamabushi kill Keiga during their attack on the Minamo school.
timeline.quote: She was killed by Hidetsugu and his yamabushi minions during their attack on the school.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jugan is summoned by the monks of the Order of the Sacred Bell to fight in the Battle of Silk and is killed.
timeline.quote: In the initial stages of the war, he was summoned by the monks of the Order of the Sacred Bell to fight in the Battle of Silk .

citation.text: "Kami", section "Dragon spirits". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians kill kami en masse.
timeline.quote: As they have no flesh to be compleated, they were killed en masse by the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Kami", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Damage from the Apocalypse Chime weakens the veil, letting Konda pull an aspect of O-Kagachi through it and begin the Kami War.
timeline.quote: thus beginning the Kami War .

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged kami attack the physical world to reclaim That Which Was Taken, and mortals lose a losing battle.
timeline.quote: Lord Konda's act greatly enraged the spirits, who turned against the physical world with a vengeance.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the war's twentieth year Michiko Konda frees the scion Kyodai and defeats O-Kagachi and Konda; O-Kagachi's death merges the two realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The orochi resurrect Jugan, who with Ryusei defeats the oni incursion after the Night of Withering.
timeline.quote: together, Jugan and Ryusei defeated the oni incursion.

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Shattered States era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Jukai discover overlapping realms and, with the Imperials and Minamo, build merge gates around the rifts.
timeline.quote: Through their combined effort, the mortals built gates around every new rift

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Era of Enlightenment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai defeat Konda and O-Kagachi and become guardians of the barrier between realms.
timeline.quote: defeated Konda and O-Kagachi and claimed themselves the guardians of the barrier between the Utsushiyo and the Kakuriyo.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lord Konda raids the Spirit World and tears out O-Kagachi's heart, casting it as a stone disk.
timeline.quote: he tore out O-Kagachi's "heart," its divinity

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Enraged, O-Kagachi moves the other kami to strike the mortal world, beginning the Kami War.
timeline.quote: thus the Kami War began

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the twentieth year, O-Kagachi first manifests, devouring three thousand warriors and defeating the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: It also defeated Hidetsugu's master, the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos easily.

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "First Manifestation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Suzue seeks out the budoka Dosan and raises her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.
timeline.quote: The orochi Suzue sought out the budoka Dosan , and raised her son Seshiro among the monks of Okina Shrine.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The kirin answer the orochi's plea and help them learn that they must give up limbs to regain the forest kami's power.
timeline.quote: In the end, it was the kirin who answered that call.

citation.text: "Snake", section "Orochi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chiyo stabs Toshi; Night's Reach forgives him and Chiyo is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Once more, Toshi swore his allegiance to her and so Chiyo was destroyed.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Takeno exhorts soldiers to rise like the sun and die as heroes.
timeline.quote: Rise like the sun, stand like the mountain, charge like the lion, die as a hero.

citation.text: Day of Destiny (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Warriors turn to face O-Kagachi and die of awe.
timeline.quote: The clashing warriors turned to face O-Kagachi, the greatest kami, and their sigh of awe was their last breath.

citation.text: Final Judgment (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oyobi splits the sky and her champions descend.
timeline.quote: Her angry call split the sky. From that rift descended her champions.

citation.text: Oyobi, Who Split the Heavens (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Konda grows suspicious that unseen hands manipulate his allies.
timeline.quote: Konda grew ever more suspicious, fearing even his most loyal allies were being manipulated by unseen hands.

citation.text: Threads of Disloyalty (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Konda falls ill with fever and sees a spirit-child offering a way to make his empire last forever.
timeline.quote: Early in his reign, Konda fell ill.

citation.text: Mannichi, the Fevered Dream (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Konda orders Takeno to find Isao, who claims no allegiance.
timeline.quote: Find him, Takeno.

citation.text: Isao, Enlightened Bushi (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hisoka asks Konda whether their graves will say they were crushed by their own arrogance.
timeline.quote: What will it say on our graves, Lord Konda?

citation.text: Hero's Demise (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yukora is freed when the ninety-nine monks who trapped him die, and seeks vengeance.
timeline.quote: Upon the death of the ninety-nine, the spell was broken, and the demon returned to the mortal world seeking vengeance for its imprisonment.

citation.text: Yukora, the Prisoner (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Oni demand ever more sacrifices from the ogres who freed them.
timeline.quote: Once freed, the oni demanded more and more sacrifices to appease them.

citation.text: Ogre Marauder (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takada faces the kami alone as last of the rearguard.
timeline.quote: Takada, last of the rearguard, faced the kami alone.

citation.text: Ashen Monstrosity (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Marrow-Gnawer orders the guard tripled against the Okiba Gang.
timeline.quote: Triple the guard!

citation.text: Nezumi Shadow-Watcher (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu holds over a dozen oni in blood oath.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu held over a dozen oni in blood oath.

citation.text: Heartless Hidetsugu (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kenzo wakes back on the battlefield after dying.
timeline.quote: But then I woke up back on the battlefield.

citation.text: Yomiji, Who Bars the Way (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Takeno chides the imperial mapmaker for arriving too late again.
timeline.quote: We arrived at the battlefield too late.

citation.text: Uproot (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Masako condemns a god held prisoner in human hands.
timeline.quote: This god held prisoner in human hands has put all humanity in the hands of angry gods.

citation.text: That Which Was Taken (Betrayers of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Toshi, in Michiko's employ and beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach, tries to honor his commitments as the Kami War threatens Kamigawa and a spirit beast threatens the world.
timeline.quote: But as the Kami War threatens to engulf Kamigawa , an unimaginably powerful spirit beast threatens the world.

citation.text: "Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk, forcing Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into the Hyozan Reckoners.
timeline.quote: then succeeds in gaining the Onna's power of frost and capturing her in a magic disk via a kanji ritual.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu plans to raze Minamo and Otawara; Toshi persuades him to attack Jukai first, and they trade items.
timeline.quote: Toshi convinces Hidetsugu that he needs more time and tells him to attack Jukai first.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi goes through the Shadow Gate and barters with Night's Reach for teleportation power, kills Uramon, teleports Michiko to Pearl-Ear and mercy kills Choryu.
timeline.quote: Toshi also teleports to Hidetsugu's lair and mercy kills Choryu despite knowing it would enrage Hidetsugu.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Night's Reach calls in Toshi's debt and has him leave the Hyozan Reckoners, though his intentions secretly diverge from hers.
timeline.quote: Night's Reach cashes in on the favor Toshi owes her.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strain on the veil begins to show near the end of the Kami War.
timeline.quote: The strain upon the veil between worlds began to show near the end of the Kami War.

citation.text: Aether Shockwave (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mothriders join the fray in a great battle.
timeline.quote: The mothriders had joined the fray.

citation.text: Eiganjo Free-Riders (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Michiko Konda leaves home, promising to return only once her father is brought back to his senses.
timeline.quote: I won't come home until I find out how to bring him back to his senses, and Kamigawa is again at peace.

citation.text: Michiko Konda, Truth Seeker (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Masako recounts Konda's belief that he would not lose the Kami War.
timeline.quote: Konda never once believed he would lose the Kami War.

citation.text: Reverence (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kami passing through the veil weaken it.
timeline.quote: The more kami that passed through the veil that separated them from our world, the weaker that veil became

citation.text: Cut the Earthly Bond (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shiro is caught in a mist that kills his comrades.
timeline.quote: Shiro fought his way to fresh air only to look back and see his comrades fallen on the battlefield behind him.

citation.text: Kagemaro's Clutch (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Minor kami spill through a rip in the veil and vanish.
timeline.quote: Through the veil's rip spilled hundreds of minor kami

citation.text: Glitterfang (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kami trapped for eons within the sacred gong destroy their prison.
timeline.quote: Trapped for eons within the sacred gong, the kami boomed and clanged to a deafening tempo as they destroyed their erstwhile prison.

citation.text: Sunder from Within (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Senka leaves her colony to found a new one as broodmistress.
timeline.quote: Senka left the colony of her birth and, with her attendants, set out to serve as broodmistress, founder of a new colony.

citation.text: Seed the Land (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Monks transcribe the tattoos of Reki's body after his death, producing The History of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body

citation.text: Reki, the History of Kamigawa (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Even the benevolent kirin join the war against the mortal world.
timeline.quote: Even the most benevolent and life-giving of kami joined the war against the mortal world

citation.text: Bounteous Kirin (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The sisters take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology and plan a blending of the two worlds.
timeline.quote: The sisters then take O-Kagachi's place in Kamigawa's cosmology.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu devours the failed oni, becomes the most formidable demonic entity, and is imprisoned in the spirit realm by Kyodai.
timeline.quote: His cruelties and the destruction he wreaked throughout the land caused Kyodai to personally intervene and imprison him in the spirit realm

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "After the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko and Kyodai assume O-Kagachi's role as guardian of the veil; the war ends.
timeline.quote: The war ended soon after the Serpent's defeat

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi's death breaks down the barrier, merging the spirit and mortal realms.
timeline.quote: The death of O-Kagachi caused the barrier between the two realms to break down

citation.text: "O-Kagachi", section "The Battle for the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi, despite avoiding the conflict, becomes the center of the war between the spirit and human realms.
timeline.quote: But despite his best efforts, he's not only involved in it, he's at the center of it.

citation.text: "Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi and Princess Michiko must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami.
timeline.quote: he must find a way to stave off the impending victory of the kami

citation.text: "Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Centuries later the Sisters order Leshrac to leave their plane.
timeline.quote: the Sisters stood in his way and ordered him to go away from their plane.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Future Sight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace defeats Tezzeret on Kamigawa, obliterating his mind and causing the Fall of the Infinite Consortium.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret lost this duel against Jace after they planeswalked to Kamigawa

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace amputates Tezzeret's etherium arm with the manablade.
timeline.quote: he lost his etherium arm when Jace amputated it with his manablade

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret is left brain-dead for ratfolk to find, and Bolas later takes his body.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret was left brain-dead in the burned village for the ratfolk to find

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Agents of Artifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a young student, Tamiyo discovers a book from outside her plane and her spark ignites.
timeline.quote: The excitement she experienced thinking of the possibilities made her spark ignite

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Ignition". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana frees Jace and Jace lures Tezzeret to Kamigawa, where he dismembers him, tearing off his etherium arm.
timeline.quote: dueled and dismembered Tezzeret, tearing off his etherium arm and crippling his mind

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani visits Tamiyo's home after witnessing Elspeth's death, and she lets him stay.
timeline.quote: She allowed him to stay until he was ready to move on.

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Meeting with other planeswalkers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, six months ago, Nashi plays hide-and-seek in Tamiyo's library on Kamigawa and finds a pale giant, Ajani, who is welcomed into the household.
timeline.quote: A pale giant stared down at him. One blue eye blinked.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo introduces Ajani as part of her story-circle and Nashi as part of her family.
timeline.quote: He's part of our family now.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo privately asks Ajani where Elspeth is and he says she is not coming.
timeline.quote: Where is Elspeth?

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Nashi remembers fleeing the fire as his mother was burned by a man of living flame.
timeline.quote: Mama's on fire, held aloft by a man of living flame.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says Tezzeret died three years ago, killed by Nashi's villagers and betrayed by comrades.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret died...three years ago, I think?
